meta.name: Census of India - district population 1901-2011 on 2011 district boundaries (Table A-2)
meta.source_org: Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India (Census of India 2011)
meta.url: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/43333 (India) to /43368 (one catalog page per state; the build reads the xlsx/xls file linked on each page)
meta.license: Government of India open data (Census of India)
meta.limitations: Past populations are adjusted by the Census to the 2011 district boundaries. Some cells are N.A. in the source (new districts without past data) and stay null here. The 1981 census was not held in Assam: the source has no district value for 1981 and an interpolated state value. Goa, Daman, Diu, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Puducherry used other actual census years in some decades: column year_actual holds the actual year. Census of 1951 in Puducherry was in 1948. No value is interpolated or estimated by this pipeline.
meta.method: build_census_series.py reads column Persons/Males/Females of each state file of Table A-2. Row key = '<censuscode>|<year>'. A district joins to data/ref/districts2011.csv by the district code of the file (equal to censuscode); state = state id from data/normalized/census2011_district.json. The year slot is the nominal decade year (1901 + 10 n). year_actual is set when the source year differs.

year.name: Census year (nominal decade slot)
year.description: Nominal census year. See year_actual for exceptions.

year_actual.name: Actual census year if different
year_actual.description: Set only when the census was held in another year (for example 1948 for Puducherry).

male.name: Male population
male.description: Males. Null when the source has N.A.

female.name: Female population
female.description: Females. Null when the source has N.A.
